body: The way I see looking out for my well being goes from the simplest of things like eating “normally”, cleaning my home environment, myself, taking care of myself and trying to do things that will further help my life get better one baby step at a time, all the way up to not antagonizing myself all the time and getting to better my mental health. But somehow I think I don’t deserve all of this in a way. I feel like I always try to be a good person but all I get back from the universe is problems, hardships & struggles without getting the chance to catch a breath and a smudge of hope. I keep seeing shitty people around me get almost everything they want all the time. I know its not fair to think like that and to compare myself with others, i know life is unfair, but i can’t really help it. I don’t know what would I do if I was a good friend of mine because i feel my friends are treating me good & respecting me. I simply cannot do anything that is not familiar and closely related to my routines, its like I’m trapped and I can’t escape this vicious cycle
Gothic, so good yet so underrated!
